from datetime import datetime, timedelta
now=datetime.now()
yesterday=(now-timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat()
print('now',now)
print('yesterday',yesterday)

# Login to simple_note and venmo and phone using supervisor stored passwords
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
print('creds keys', [c['account_name'] for c in creds])

simple_note_pw = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='simple_note')
venmo_pw = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='venmo')
phone_pw = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='phone')

sn = apis.simple_note.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=simple_note_pw)
print('simple_note login', sn)

vm = apis.venmo.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
print('venmo login', vm)

ph = apis.phone.login(username='7826309761', password=phone_pw)
print('phone login', ph)

sn_token = sn['access_token']

# search for likely dinner share note
query_terms = ['Work Dinner', 'work dinner', 'dinner', 'dinner shares', 'coworker']

all_found = []
for q in query_terms:
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_token, query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('search_notes', q, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        all_found.extend([(q, r['note_id'], r['title'], r.get('tags')) for r in res])
        if len(res) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1

print('total found rows', len(all_found))
# Show unique note_ids
uniq = {}
for q,nid,title,tags in all_found:
    uniq[nid] = (title,tags)
print('unique note_ids', len(uniq))
print(sorted([(nid,)+uniq[nid] for nid in uniq], key=lambda x:x[0])[:50])

sn_token = sn['access_token']
notes = [3084,3085]
shares = {}
for nid in notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=sn_token)
    content = note.get('content','')
    # parse lines like '- Kayla => $20'
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- ') and '=>' in line:
            # remove leading '- '
            part=line[2:]
            name_part, amt_part = part.split('=>')
            name=name_part.strip()
            amt_str=amt_part.strip()
            if amt_str.startswith('$'):
                amt=float(amt_str[1:].strip())
            else:
                amt=float(amt_str)
            shares[name]=shares.get(name,0)+amt
print('shares totals:', shares)
print('names:', list(shares.keys()))
